plantCalculator.title: Plan your plant capacity in seconds.
plantCalculator.description: Select your target application and test capacity scenarios from 10 to 1,000 KLD. Review immediate hydraulic flow rates, estimated recycled water recovery, and recommended process technology.

applications.name: Residential & Commercial Sewage
applications.technology: MBBR or SBR biological aeration & clarification
applications.designObjective: BOD < 10 ppm and TSS < 10 ppm for flush and landscape irrigation reuse.
applications.description: Engineered for townships, IT campuses, and commercial developments seeking zero fresh-water waste in toilet flushing and horticulture.

applications.name: Industrial Chemical & Dye Effluent
applications.designObjective: COD/BOD/heavy metal reduction conforming to strict SPCB/CPCB industrial discharge limits.
applications.description: Heavy-duty skid systems engineered for textile dyeing, pharmaceuticals, electroplating, and manufacturing effluent streams.

applications.name: High-Pressure Boiler Feed & Pure Water
applications.technology: Two-bed ion exchange with mixed-bed polishing
applications.designObjective: Conductivity < 0.2 µS/cm and silica < 0.02 ppm for zero-scaling thermal operations.
applications.description: Ion-exchange columns built for power utilities, paper mills, and pharmaceutical loops demanding zero electrical conductivity.

applications.name: Groundwater & High-TDS Desalination
applications.technology: High-pressure membrane separation with anti-scalant dosing
applications.designObjective: Up to 80% permeate recovery with >99.2% salt rejection across high-TDS feeds.
applications.description: Multi-stage brackish and sea water reverse osmosis skids equipped with energy recovery turbines and PLC control.

applications.name: Hard-Water Scale Prevention
applications.technology: Sodium-cycle cation resin with automatic multi-port valve
applications.designObjective: Hardness reduction to < 5 ppm as CaCO₃ to protect cooling towers, chillers, and boilers.
applications.description: Turnkey industrial water softeners eliminating calcium and magnesium scale formation across heat-exchange equipment.
